inputs.name: NavigationValidator.validate.value
inputs.description: The navigation URL to check, which may be any value at runtime. Only a string can pass, and it must parse as an absolute URL with protocol 'harness:', hostname 'app', and no username or password; any non-string returns false without parsing.

outputs.name: NavigationValidator.validate
outputs.description: The validation verdict: true only when the input is a string that parses as an absolute URL with protocol 'harness:', hostname 'app', and no username or password. Every other input returns false, including non-strings and strings that are not valid absolute URLs; validate never throws.
